name: Stealth Amplifier - Link
RelatedDescription: This advanced optics system can distort light, allowing ST fitted with this backpack model to become somewhat invisible. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Link capability.

61224.name: Invisibility Device I · Link
61224.SpecificEffects:
At the end of the action, if there are no enemies within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area, gain <buf ID=3004502>[Stealth I]</buf> with a trigger interval of <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.
When launching Link Attack, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
